description: Validate the BGP route-origin of an IP or prefix against RPKI (via RIPEstat): valid / invalid / unknown for the announcing ASN and covering prefix. 'invalid' means the origin isn't authorised by a ROA (possible hijack or misconfiguration); 'unknown' means no ROA covers the prefix. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Read-only.

target.description: IP address, CIDR prefix, or host name — e.g. 193.0.6.139, 193.0.0.0/21 or example.com

name: rpki_validation
